title: Renewal, Nonrenewal, Expiration and Late Renewal: Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Conditions
content:
A Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is renewed term by term on a renewal offer.

## 1. The renewal offer

- The renewal offer is issued the package's renewal lead time in calendar days before the term expiration date.
- The offer names the renewal package chosen under the package eligibility rules, and the renewal full-term premium rated under the full-term rating rule.
- The customer may choose a different renewal package on the offer, as long as that package passes its entry gates. The renewal is issued on the package recorded on the offer.

## 2. Issuing the renewal term

The renewal term is issued when the renewal down payment set by billing is paid on or before the expiration date. The policy fee is billed again for the new term. A policy whose renewal is not paid by the expiration date expires.

## 3. Company nonrenewal

A company nonrenewal requires a nonrenewal notice mailed at least the package's nonrenewal notice period (45 calendar days on every package) before the term expiration date. A notice mailed later than that cannot nonrenew the term, and the policy is offered renewal instead.

The policy is nonrenewed at expiration only when a nonrenewal notice for that term was mailed no later than 45 calendar days before the term expiration date. The mailing date is read from the notice recorded for that term.

| Notice for the term mailed | Result at expiration |
|---|---|
| 45 or more calendar days before expiration | Nonrenewed |
| Fewer than 45 calendar days before expiration | Cannot nonrenew; renewal is offered |

Boundary (hypothetical): a notice mailed exactly 45 days before the expiration date is in time; one mailed 44 days before is not.

## 4. Late renewal after expiration for unpaid renewal

- A late renewal payment is accepted only within the package's late renewal window in calendar days after the expiration date. The renewal term is then issued with coverage resuming on the payment date, leaving a lapse from the expiration date to the payment date. The term expiration date is not moved.
- **Time rule.** A late renewal is accepted only when the payment is received no later than the window's number of calendar days after the policy expired for nonpayment of the renewal. Days are counted from the end date on the policy record, the end date being day 0, and a payment on the last day of the window is accepted.
- A payment after the window is refunded, and the customer must apply for new business.
- A lapse is reported on the policy record and breaks continuous Cardinal tenure for accident forgiveness.

Boundary (hypothetical, Cardinal Auto Basic, 10-day window):

| Payment received on | Day count from the end date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1st calendar day after the end date | 1 | Accepted; lapse from the expiration date to the payment date |
| 10th calendar day after the end date | 10 | Accepted; lapse from the expiration date to the payment date |
| 11th calendar day after the end date | 11 | Refunded; new business application required |
